expected_warnings.gap: a timer has no mode in simavr until its control register is first written, where the part resets to normal mode with its clock stopped; a compare register written before then is stored, as the part stores it, and simavr warns

not_modelled: pulse-width compare registers: a write to OCR0A, OCR0B, OCR1A or OCR1B takes effect at once, where the part buffers it in every PWM mode and updates it at the end of the period
fast PWM with a compare value equal to TOP: the output is held at its compare-match level for the period, where the part holds it at its BOTTOM level
a change of the clock prescaler takes effect at the write, where the part switches between T1 + T2 and T1 + 2 T2 after it

a timer has no mode in simavr until its control register is first written, where the part resets to normal mode with its clock stopped; a compare register written before then is stored, as the part stores it, and simavr warns
